about: Full-stack engineer with 13 years shipping production software. At Dialpad I work in TypeScript, React and Next.js on a site of about 1,900 pages in five locales, with GraphQL and Contentful behind it. On my own time I have shipped three products alone, and all three are live. Running under the last decade is a thread of visual builders, which turn content models into systems non-engineers can drive.
